instruction: Speak in Spanish. Deliver this with a building sense of urgency, starting slow and methodical, and getting faster and faster until the end.
text: Primero, tienes que entender el concepto básico, que es fundamental. Luego, aplicas la fórmula a los datos que te hemos dado. A partir de ahí, los cálculos se vuelven más sencillos y puedes resolver el resto del problema con mucha más agilidad.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio clearly demonstrates the requested temporal progression, starting at a methodical pace and accelerating to a fast, urgent delivery by the end.

instruction_evidence.speed_progression: The speaker begins at a steady, measured pace, visibly speeds up in the second sentence, and delivers the final sentence very rapidly.
instruction_evidence.urgency: The tone builds in intensity alongside the speed, effectively conveying a growing sense of urgency.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech sounds smooth and human-like, with natural transitions between the different speeds.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The dynamic shifts in tempo and energy are well-shaped and highly appropriate for the intended progression.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Start off speaking quietly with a worried tone, but build in volume and intensity, ending in an angry shout.
text: Les expliqué la situación una y otra vez, pero parecía que no me escuchaban. Repetí todos los detalles, les mostré los documentos, y aun así no hicieron nada. ¡Es increíble que después de todo eso, todavía me digan que es mi culpa!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio ends with a loud, angry shout, but fails to start quietly or with a worried tone. Instead, it begins moderately loud and annoyed, resulting in a flattened dynamic progression.

instruction_evidence.progression_volume: Starts at a moderate to loud volume rather than quiet, but does build up to a shout by the end.
instruction_evidence.progression_emotion: The beginning sounds annoyed rather than worried, weakening the emotional contrast and making the progression to anger less impactful.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. I want you to begin with an unnaturally high-pitched voice, then transition smoothly down to your normal vocal range by the end of the sentence.
text: ¡Ay, qué susto! Pensé que algo malo había pasado. Pero no, ya veo que estás bien. Menos mal. Vamos a sentarnos un momento, y me cuentas qué ha sucedido con tranquilidad.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio fails to execute the requested pitch progression. The voice maintains a relatively consistent pitch throughout the entire text, missing the unnaturally high start and the smooth transition to a normal range.

instruction_evidence.pitch_progression: There is no audible transition; the pitch remains consistent from the beginning to the end of the text.
instruction_evidence.initial_pitch: The audio does not start with an unnaturally high-pitched voice.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. As you read this, I want your emotion to change. Begin neutrally, then transition to surprise, and finally to joy.
text: Recibí una nota de la oficina central, dice que revise el anexo B. A ver... un momento... ¡No me lo puedo creer! ¡Me han concedido la beca para estudiar en el extranjero el próximo año!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio begins neutrally and increases in energy later on, but the distinct stages of surprise and joy are flattened and mostly conveyed through slight volume and speed changes rather than clear emotional shifts.

instruction_evidence.neutral_start: The beginning is delivered with a flat, neutral tone.
instruction_evidence.surprise_to_joy_transition: The transition to surprise and joy is very weak, characterized only by a slight increase in pace and volume rather than genuine emotional inflection.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Begin speaking with a hesitant, uncertain tone, but as you continue, your voice should become firm and decisive.
text: He estado pensando mucho en las opciones... y... bueno, no ha sido fácil. Pero después de considerarlo todo, he llegado a una conclusión. Me quedo aquí para terminar el proyecto.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The delivery is completely flat regarding the requested progression. The speaker sounds confident and firm from the very beginning, failing to convey the initial hesitant and uncertain tone.

instruction_evidence.hesitant_start: Absent. The speaker reads the first sentences with a fast, fluid, and confident tone, despite the pauses in the text.
instruction_evidence.firm_ending: The ending sounds firm, but only because the entire audio is spoken in the same firm, neutral tone.
instruction_evidence.progression: Absent. There is no audible shift or temporal progression in the tone.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not evaluated due to low instruction-following score.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not evaluated due to low instruction-following score.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Begin this line in a very slow, very quiet manner. As you speak, build to a normal volume and speed, as if a thought is solidifying in your mind.
text: Parece que... la vida es una serie de puertas... y al final, no se trata de cuántas abrimos, sino de si tuvimos el coraje de cruzar el umbral de las más importantes.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio clearly realizes the dynamic progression, starting slowly and quietly, and gradually building up to a normal speed and volume, matching the requested scenario.

instruction_evidence.speed: Starts with a slow pace and pauses, gradually increasing to a normal conversational speed.
instruction_evidence.volume: Starts softer/quieter and builds up to a normal volume towards the end of the sentence.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds human-like and smooth without synthetic artifacts.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery captures the thoughtful, solidifying nature of the realization perfectly.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Begin this line in a low-pitched, sad voice. Transition into a more neutral, pensive delivery with a normal pitch by the end.
text: Esa casa ya no está, la demolieron hace años. A veces me pregunto si los lugares guardan los ecos de las risas que una vez contuvieron.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio completely fails to follow the dynamic instruction. It does not start with a low-pitched or sad voice, and there is no transition to a pensive delivery.

instruction_evidence.pitch_progression: The pitch starts relatively high rather than low, and remains somewhat high throughout without a clear transition to normal.
instruction_evidence.emotion_progression: The delivery lacks any sadness at the beginning and does not sound pensive at the end; the tone is fast and emotionally flat.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech sounds very synthetic, rushed, and unnatural.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery lacks the requested emotional depth and expressive variation.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Begin this line slowly, as if you are begging. Then, your tone should become strong and defiant, and your speaking rate should get faster.
text: Te lo ruego, considera lo que te estoy diciendo, es importante para ambos. Pero si no quieres verlo, está bien. ¡Yo seguiré mi propio camino y demostraré que tengo razón!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The dynamic progression is completely absent. The audio is fast and aggressive from the very beginning, failing to start slowly or convey a begging tone.

instruction_evidence.speed_progression: The speaking rate is fast throughout the entire audio, with no transition from slow to fast.
instruction_evidence.tone_progression: The tone is strong and aggressive right from the start, lacking any pleading or begging quality in the beginning.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Deliver this line with a progression of emotions and volume: begin happy and normal, then become worried and quiet, and conclude fearful and very quiet.
text: ¡Qué bien, por fin llegamos a la cabaña! Es un poco más vieja de lo que recordaba, y la puerta está entreabierta. Un momento... creo que hay alguien adentro.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: There is a slight volume decrease towards the end, but the requested emotional progression (happy to worried to fearful) is completely missing, resulting in a flattened and robotic delivery.

instruction_evidence.emotion_progression: The voice sounds flat and synthetic throughout, failing to clearly convey happiness, worry, or fear at any stage.
instruction_evidence.volume_progression: There is a weak but noticeable decrease in volume from the beginning to the end, partially fulfilling the volume instruction.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech is highly robotic, stiff, and lacks humanlike intonation.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is extremely monotonous and lacks any meaningful expressive variation.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your delivery needs three distinct phases. Phase one: quiet, slow, thoughtful. Phase two: a furious climax, very loud and very fast. Phase three: quiet, slow, sad resignation.
text: Uno intenta construir algo, pieza por pieza, con cuidado. ¡Y luego llegas tú y lo destruyes todo en un segundo sin pensarlo! Y yo... me quedo aquí, entre las ruinas.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio completely fails to follow the requested progression. The entire delivery is fast and loud, lacking the quiet, slow, and thoughtful first phase, as well as the quiet, slow, and sad third phase.

instruction_evidence.Phase 1 (quiet, slow, thoughtful): The beginning of the audio is fast and loud, contrary to the instruction.
instruction_evidence.Phase 2 (furious, loud, fast): This is present, but it matches the general tone of the entire audio rather than being a distinct climax.
instruction_evidence.Phase 3 (quiet, slow, sad): The ending remains fast and relatively loud without any sense of sad resignation.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not evaluated as instruction following is bad.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not evaluated as instruction following is bad.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your tone should shift back and forth between sarcastic and complaining. Start sarcastic, then get whiny, and then return to sarcasm.
text: Me encanta trabajar en equipo, es lo mejor. Especialmente cuando soy el único que hace todo el trabajo. Es genial ver cómo los demás se relajan mientras yo paso la noche en vela. Pero claro, el mérito será para todos por igual, ¡qué justo! Ya estoy harto, ¿por qué siempre tengo que cargar con todo? Es increíble que a nadie más le importe.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The delivery is highly monotonous, robotic, and rushed. The requested dynamic shifts between sarcastic and complaining/whiny are absent, with the emotional cues relying entirely on the text rather than audible prosodic changes.

instruction_evidence.sarcastic_start: The opening is read very quickly and flatly, with no clear sarcastic inflection.
instruction_evidence.complaining_middle: The middle section lacks any whiny or complaining tone, continuing the same rushed pacing.
instruction_evidence.sarcastic_end: There is no return to a distinct sarcastic tone; the delivery remains uniform and flat throughout.
